summary: Steel tower, 30 m, that Alberta's register dates to 2004; listed as active with road access. No other source found describes it.

access.note: Register lists the tower as active with drive access. No source found says whether the public may visit the site.

events.note: Register gives 2004 as the year of construction for the tower.

evidence.quote: each lookout operator is responsible for locating and reporting wildfires within a 40-kilometre (25-mile) radius

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Alberta register row and two general Alberta pages were found. Two searches turned up no Chinchaga-specific history. The name matches the 1950 Chinchaga fire and Chinchaga Wildland Provincial Park (whose centre lies about 1.2 degrees of longitude west of the tower), but no source found ties the tower to either, so the story does not. Brief built 2004 matches the register. Brief access closed is corrected to restricted (active, drive access). The register query is the all-records query (where=1=1) because the name-filtered query returned a server error. The agency name follows the Alberta.ca bears page wording; the brief said Alberta Wildfire.
